decisions.reason: Rule 11: C2 (abstract), C13 and C15 (conclusion, p.150) make the same assertion (partnerships weakly collaborative, not between equals) and become one row listing both locations. Rules 7-8: rests on F22, F25 (shared decision making, argued in the conclusion via C14) and F9 (resources, p.146). F4 not carried over (rule 3): it measures scope of activity, and p.146 calls the activities frequently collaborative.
Rule 11: replaced by the single row C26.
Rule 2 / rule 4: C26 covers C14, which narrows it to shared decision making (p.150, 'a key ingredient of collaboration'; 'In short'). Replaces R3 and R4.
Point to C13 and C15, rejected under rule 11; the link is carried by R6.
Rule 10: C9 and C10 are adjacent sentences (p.150) with no marker of the link (no therefore, so, this suggests); sequence alone is not a relation.
